music.name: 碓氷悠一朗(塚越雄一朗)

segments.text: Likes: all things erotic, Japanese sake, horseracing
Skills: guessing women's three sizes just by looking

The founder and the lead programmer of the video game development company "Judgement 7". Technically the representative of Judgement 7, but possibly due to his perverted nature, he isn't very respected by the members. As a matter of fact, he is a master programmer capable of creating super-perverted software that no ordinary person could write.
海野 悠太 Umino Yuuta
Likes: fantasy worlds, animation in general, chicken nanban

Owari's friend since their college days. He is responsible for planning, scenario and setting. Co-founded Judgement 7 with Owari. A hardcore setting otaku, he wilfully creates settings that are so complex and strange that the average person would never understand them. Often lets out odd shrieks during work, which has earned him the nickname "kiseichuu".
早瀬 麻乃 Hayase Asano
Skill: breaking any equipment she touches

Hayase Yuuno's older sister. As a sound creator, she is responsible for composing background music and creating sound effects. Even though she is a composer, she is hopelessly tonedeaf and unaware of it herself. She is "blessed" with the ability to break computers and machinery. She is a haphazard person who doesn't mind that parts of her musical keyboard no longer make any sound.
結城 七海 Yuuki Natsumi

A new-style designer who lives in the office of Judgement 7. Although she has a sharp tongue and is sometimes strict with others, she is also strict with herself and always works seriously. She will be happy as long as she just gets to draw, and as such she is responsible for character designs, art direction, user interfaces, logos, and all other graphics in Judgement 7's games.

cast.characterName: タチアナ・アレクサンドロヴナ・シャラポヴァ
cast.originalCharacterName: タチアナ・アレクサンドロヴナ・シャラポヴァ

segments.text: Likes: chocolate bars, Gajigaji-kun, sour milk

Although born in Russia, Tatiana has lived in Japan since she was a child. She goes to a middle school in Hokkaido while also working as a programmer at a research institute. Despite being a super genius girl also known as "Russia's Secret Treasure", her abilities other than programming are inferior in all aspects to that of other children of her age, and her sociability and ability to take care of daily activities are on the level of a grade schooler or a kindergartener.
早瀬 憂乃 Hayase Yuuno
Likes: shaved ice, Ramune, panda-themed goods

Hayase Asano's younger sister and a current high school girl. She works as a part-timer at Judgement 7 and is a "super assistant" who is capable of offering support in every task. Usually she is a carefree airhead, but should the need arise, her discernment, ability to take action and insightfulness surpass that of other members.
Real name: 御前 令二 Misaki Reiji
Likes: cola, curry rice, persimmon seeds

His real name is Misaki Reiji but Owari gave him pseudonym Gozen Reiji (meaning "midnight"). A college student who participates in game development as a part-timer. He is exceedingly ordinary and possesses both common sense and social skills, which makes him a special presence within Judgement 7.
Skills: being early to bed and early to rise, granting wishes
Role: NPC that leads humanity into depravity

A devil doll that appeared in Judgement 7's second game "Zigzag Dolls". He grants people 3 wishes in order to lead them astray down the path of desire, then carries out "Zigzag Punishment", taking away a part of the person's body proportional to the magnitude of their wishes. However, his presence is so insignificant that even Judgement 7 that had created the him can't recall his character setting in detail.

cast.characterName: エロリィ・ニューニュー
cast.originalCharacterName: エロリィ・ニューニュー

segments.text: Likes: thick things, sturdy things, rod-shaped things, bananas
Skills: squishy-squishy and other abilities involving the use of breasts
Role: NPC that guides heroes towards victory

A female NPC boasting massive 120 cm I-cup breasts whose character setting was created by Owari Sekai and who was designed by Yuuki Natsumi. She appears in Judgement 7's third game "Synchro Dive", but doesn't get much on-screen time due her clashing with the overall style of the game. She flirts with the the male members and with those involved in her creation, but is utterly harsh on Asano who has small breasts.
Likes: little kids, cute girls, capital punishment
Role: NPC who is a friend to good children

A cartoon mascot character that appeared in Judgement 7's fifth game "Rakuen Pororokka". The original deisgn was "a cute, gentle and somewhat foolish bear" by Tatiana, but Natsumi added her own touch to it by equipping its entire body with machine guns, rocket fists, railguns and the like, turning it into a cartoony ultimate killing machine.
一之瀬 玲菜 Ichinose Reina
Skills: cooking, cleaning and housework in general

A mysterious girl whom Judgement 7 met in the streets of Asakusa during New World experience. She does not even remember her own name, so she was given the name "Girl A" when she tagged along with Judgement 7. She seems to be pursued by unidentified people in black suits and to be deeply involved with the New World.

A woman who serves as a waitress at cafe EXIT in the New World. She excels in martial arts and also seems to be knowledgeable enough about the New World, but is also deep down a carefree and easy-going person, making her quite difficult to figure out. She has surprisingly loose-lipped and carelessly slips out important information, and so she is always frowned upon by Deguchi.
Skills: making curry, roasting coffee, fighting

A man who works as the manager of Cafe EXIT in the New World. At a glance he doesn't seem like the typical coffee shop proprietor, but it is said that once he receives an order he can prepare it with no mistakes and with precise skill, and that he can make first-rate curry, so his ability as the manager is undeniable.

cast.characterName: ユーリー・ダヴィードヴィチ・シャラポフ
cast.originalCharacterName: ユーリー・ダヴィードヴィチ・シャラポフ

segments.text: Skill: knowledge of science in general
Role: deputy director of Hokuren Institute of Physical and Chemical Research

Born in Russia. He is a scientist working as the deputy director of Hokuren Institute of Physical and Chemical Research. He is Tatiana's father as well as an old friend of Owari and Iruka No. 2 from their college days. While he is a rational scientist, he loses control over himself and turns into a doting parent when talking about his daughter Tatiana. However, he is busy as the deputy director and doesn't get to spend much time with her.
Role: researcher who just happens to pass by

A woman who is a former researcher at Hokuren Institute of Physical and Chemical Research where she worked under Yuriy, the deputy director. She is a talented woman who specializes in neuroscience and is currently working as an assistant professor at the university that Reiji attends. At a glance she seems like a levelheaded adult woman, but on the inside she obsesses and gets excited over passionate relationships between men both real and fictional, so she has some quite "rotten" interests.
Skill: superhuman fighting through the use of admin rights

A mysterious man who stands in the way of the Judgement 7 as they are trying to escape from the New World. Because he hides his face using digital mosaic, Owari gave him the name "Obscenity Man". In addition to his face, his voice also has effects added to it, so his true identity is a complete mystery. He uses "admin rights" that can interfere with the rules of nature of the New World and is also in control of his underlings, the men in black suits.
Skill: abusive talk, harsh remarks, recklessness

A mysterious high school girl who appeared before Judgement 7 while they were lodging at Minamiboso. She picks fights with Judgement 7 by using abusive talk and harsh remarks. Self-centered, quick-tempered and irritable, this troublesome girl is hard to have a talk with.

cast.characterName: 斑鳩・F・スバルスカイ
cast.originalCharacterName: 斑鳩・F・スバルスカイ

segments.text: Age: not bound by such a thing as age
Likes: one who charms others has no such thing as likes
Skills: stopping time, manipulating flames, charming women
Role: the king who rules over all

A dodgy-looking guy who suddenly appeared in the streets of Asakusa. Calling himself the king of violet flames, this arrogant person is always looking down on others. Controlling azure and scarlet flames, his magic power is infinite. In addition, he can use time-stopping ability known as "time interference," bringing even light to a halt and turning the world monochromatic.

A mysterious angel-like being that appeared in Asakusa that had turned into a closed space. She is not a character from Judgement 7's games, and her true nature, aims, and everything else remains a mystery. Only one thing is for certain: that she is trying to imprison Judgement 7 in this closed-up world.
Likes: Gozen Reiji, Misaki Reiji, Ree-kun

A university student who attends the same Toushou University as Reiji. She is a stalker girl who is convinced that she is Reiji's lover and pops up to play girlfriend wherever he goes. She calls him "Ree-kun" and always carries around a plushie whose clothes modeled after his. Her actions are unpredictable and come out of nowhere. She is quite clumsy even though she doesn't realize it herself.
Real name: 海野 くらら Umino Kurara
Likes: Iruka No. 2's sense of worldbuilding, light novels, studying

Iruka No. 2's little sister whose real name is Umino Kurara. She adores her big brother and even lets out strange shrieks in imitation of him even though she is clearly trying too hard, sometimes letting her true girlish side show and reveal just how irresolute and full of holes her inner character setting is. She longs for her big brother's lifestyle and has debuted her look in middle school, but her real character is a secret even to her classmates.
